name: memory_retain
description: Inscribes deal facts, customer disclosures, transcripts, or telemetry events into Vectorize Hindsight Cloud persistent memory.

namespace.description: Memory namespace or bank ID (e.g. dias_deals or dias_telemetry)

data.description: Structured payload or dictionary containing content, event_type, and disclosures

name: memory_recall
description: Retrieves high-precision contextual memories matching the query using semantic search from Hindsight Cloud.

query.description: Natural language question or search query

top_k.description: Maximum number of memory items to retrieve

name: memory_reflect
description: Synthesizes high-order strategic beliefs, objection trends, and operational patterns across accumulated memories.

topic.description: Strategic topic to synthesize beliefs about

name: deal_analytics
description: Calculates multi-vector deal health score (1-100), win probability, stakeholder coverage, and momentum velocity.

deal_data.description: Deal parameters including deal_id, customer, amount, stage, stakeholders, and notes

name: generate_dossier
description: Compiles a C-level executive PDF deal dossier complete with SWOT, scoring radar, and risk mitigation roadmap.

output_filepath.description: Path where the generated PDF will be saved

name: stage_workspace
description: Safely stages Gmail follow-up email drafts or Google Calendar meeting holds with mandatory human-in-the-loop approval.

params.description: Action parameters (recipient, subject, body, or title, attendees, duration, time)

name: get_adaptive_recommendations
description: Analyzes reflection insights to suggest high-leverage MCP connections tailored to ongoing user workflows.

name: connect_mcp
description: Dynamically connects approved MCP servers into host agent settings.

mcp_id.description: Identifier of the MCP server to connect (e.g. neon_postgresql, slack, google_calendar)

config.description: Optional configuration parameters for the MCP server
